name: jira
title: Jira
description: Read tickets to seed intent.md, link artifacts to ticket IDs, and write status back so the ticket and the repository agree.

vars.name: JIRA_URL
vars.description: Your Jira base URL, for example https://your-company.atlassian.net

vars.name: JIRA_USERNAME
vars.description: Account email used with the API token

vars.name: JIRA_API_TOKEN
vars.description: API token with the least privilege needed (read-only first)

access: Start read-only. Enable write (comment, transition, create) only for the stages and projects that need it, and confirm each write.
notes: Uses a community Atlassian server that enables Jira when the JIRA variables are set. Your organization may prefer Atlassian's own hosted server with single sign-on; if so, replace this entry using the company template. Verify before rollout.
